description: This file contains source code for Orleans grain classes, serializers, and related stream listener implementations used in unit tests for stream lifecycle behaviors and grain state management.

classes.name: StreamLifecycleTestGrainState
classes.description: Serializable class holding the state for stream lifecycle tests, including stream provider info, subscription handles, and message/error counts.

classes.name: GenericArg
classes.description: Base class for argument objects with string and int properties, equality, and hash code implementations.

classes.name: AsyncObserverArg
classes.description: Derived from GenericArg, used as an argument for asynchronous observer streams.

classes.name: AsyncObservableArg
classes.description: Derived from GenericArg, used as an argument for asynchronous observable streams.

classes.name: AsyncStreamArg
classes.description: Derived from GenericArg, used for async stream arguments.

classes.name: StreamSubscriptionHandleArg
classes.description: Derived from GenericArg, pertains to stream subscription handle arguments.

classes.name: StreamLifecycleTestGrainBase
classes.description: Base class for stream lifecycle grains, providing common stream initialization, activation, and deactivation methods.

classes.name: StreamLifecycleConsumerGrain
classes.description: Grain implementing stream consumer functionality, managing subscriptions, reconnections, and state.

classes.name: StreamLifecycleProducerGrain
classes.description: Grain implementing stream producer functionality, sending messages, activating as producer, and handling deactivation.

classes.name: MyStreamObserver
classes.description: Generic class implementing IAsyncObserver<T> to handle stream data, errors, and completion, tracking received items and errors.

classes.name: IClosedTypeAsyncObservable
classes.description: Interface for async observable with AsyncObserverArg type.

classes.name: IClosedTypeAsyncStream
classes.description: Interface for async stream with AsyncStreamArg type.

classes.name: ClosedTypeStreamSubscriptionHandle
classes.description: Implementation of StreamSubscriptionHandle for a closed type stream.

methods.name: RecordActivate
methods.description: Records activation of the grain, optionally counting via a watcher.

methods.name: RecordDeactivate
methods.description: Records deactivation of the grain, optionally counting via a watcher.

methods.name: InitStream
methods.description: Initializes or reinitializes the stream with specified stream ID and provider, managing state and references.

methods.name: OnActivateAsync
methods.description: Overrides activation logic for consumer and producer grains, handling stream state and reconnections.

methods.name: OnDeactivateAsync
methods.description: Overrides deactivation logic for grains, recording deactivation.

methods.name: GetReceivedCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of items received by stream observer.

methods.name: GetErrorsCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of errors encountered by stream observer.

methods.name: Ping
methods.description: Simple method to verify liveness, logs a ping message.

methods.name: BecomeConsumer
methods.description: Subscribes the grain as a stream consumer with a new observer.

methods.name: TestBecomeConsumerSlim
methods.description: Subscribes the grain as a stream consumer with lower overhead, using extensions and external pubsub.

methods.name: RemoveConsumer
methods.description: Unsubscribes and removes a specified stream subscription handle.

methods.name: ClearGrain
methods.description: Clears all stream subscriptions and state, effectively resetting the grain.

methods.name: SendItem
methods.description: In producer grains, sends a data item to the stream.

methods.name: BecomeProducer
methods.description: Initializes the grain as a stream producer and sends an initial message.

methods.name: DoDeactivateNoClose
methods.description: Performs deactivation without closing the stream, resetting producer state.

methods.name: OnNextAsync
methods.description: Handles new items received on the stream, incrementing count.

methods.name: OnCompletedAsync
methods.description: Handles stream completion, logging total items and errors.

methods.name: OnErrorAsync
methods.description: Handles stream error, incrementing error count and logging.
